3	// kneading on the west column (x=18), flour stores, wood and the peel on the east column (x=20). The smoker

5	import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";
6	
7	const LEGEND_Y2 = {
8	  b: ["barrel", { facing: "up" }], // flour barrel
9	  h: "hay_block", // flour sacks
10	  w: ["water_cauldron", { level: "3" }], // kneading trough
11	  p: "spruce_planks", // dough counter
12	  g: ["spruce_log", { axis: "x" }], // wood stack by the side door
13	  f: "spruce_fence", // peel post
14	  S: ["smoker", { facing: "north", lit: "true" }], // beside the oven mouth
15	};
16	
17	const LEGEND_Y3 = {
18	  l: ["lantern", { hanging: "false" }], // standing on a barrel or the counter
19	  c: "cake", // bread loaves on the counter
20	  t: ["spruce_slab", { type: "top" }], // peel head on the post
21	};
22	
23	export function build(g) {
24	  // y=2 floor-level furniture; rows run along +z from z=14, columns are x=18,19,20
25	  layers(g, [18, 2, 14], LEGEND_Y2, [
26	    "b h", // z=14: flour barrel west, flour sacks east
27	    "   ", // z=15: shop doorway row, keep clear
28	    "w  ", // z=16: kneading trough
29	    "w  ", // z=17: kneading trough (side door row, east cell clear)
30	    "p g", // z=18: dough counter, wood stack
31	    "p g", // z=19: dough counter, wood stack
32	    "p  ", // z=20: dough counter
33	    "S f", // z=21: smoker at the oven mouth, peel post
34	  ]);
35	  layers(g, [18, 3, 14], LEGEND_Y3, [
36	    "l  ", // z=14: lantern on the barrel
37	    "   ",
38	    "   ",
39	    "   ",
40	    "c  ", // z=18: loaf on the counter
41	    "l  ", // z=19: lantern on the counter
42	    "c  ", // z=20: loaf on the counter
43	    "  t", // z=21: peel head
44	  ]);
45	}
